answer: Each challenge commits to a task seed derived from a specified future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse; until that pulse is published, its unpredictable value makes valid solutions impractical to precompute or farm offline. After reveal, nodes must answer within a bounded window and bind responses to the pulse and task, so cached work cannot be replayed across identities. A vertex in the task graph may reference copper and trellis parameters, but verification remains deterministic and public.
